subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback run automatically when no media is extracted, or stay default-off behind a channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback-style option while the channel URL fixes land?
rationale: The default changes existing deployments through extra Graph reads, permissions expectations, and diagnostics, while current behavior drops real attachments when Teams strips HTML attachment IDs.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Adopt a config-gated fallback so existing installs keep the mention-only protection unless operators explicitly opt into extra Graph message reads.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for all non-personal HTML activities with no media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only noise.

options.title: Combine the fix candidates
options.body: Ask one branch to cover channel aadGroupId/reply URL fixes and group-chat fallback gating so the compatibility story lands once.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt a config-gated fallback so existing installs keep the mention-only protection unless operators explicitly opt into extra Graph message reads.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent current-main ownership signal on the affected msteams media files, and the remaining question is a compatibility/product default decision.
